memories_after: [Fact] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, the pre-merge check runs server-side and its script is not available inside the worktree; agenium.toml leaves checks.pre_merge empty and README.md does not describe the server-side pre-merge format rules, so the required format must be learned from failure messages or inferred from git history.

[Fact] (ticket:AGN-2 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, deliverable files under deliverables/ and reports/ conventionally start with first line exactly 'Owner: docs-team'; the pre-merge check rejects files without it. This convention is inferred from hello.txt's git history rather than documented rules.

[Lesson] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) When writing deliverable files, check the project's pre-merge validation rules first instead of relying on acceptance criteria alone, since the merge gate can enforce extra format requirements.

[Fact] (ticket:AGN-1 {"project":"docs"}) In the docs project, submit_report commits worktree changes and marks the ticket Resolved, but review and pre-merge checks still run afterwards and can reopen it.
